epistemic_note: The v1 arithmetic was already known. This protocol repairs provenance; it is not a blinded discovery of the numeric direction.
question: Can the frozen 25-percent task-balance guard and its later forward accounting be reconstructed without opening or depending on any prediction pair file or prediction-derived matrix?

allowed_inputs.hash_policy: Every input is a regular non-symlink file bound by an expected SHA-256. Summary and ledger paths must be under <snapshot>/accumulator.

forbidden_inputs: label, grade, outcome, or winner-orientation vaults
formal_checks: independent structural-gate and accumulator total agreement
current total cross-check against receipt-only independent verification
baseline run-set containment, sequence subsequence, and common-row identity
synthetic source, receipt, schema, and candidate tamper rejection
file-level trace with zero prediction-pair and outcome-path opens
fresh Linux focused and full test suite
success_claims: structural-only v2 exactly reconstructs the frozen guard
structural-only v2 exactly reconstructs the later debt accounting
reported cap and compliance statuses follow from structural counts only
forbidden_claims: the producer complied with the frozen guard unless chronology proves it
task balance implies predictor accuracy or search utility
v1 artifacts met the strict zero-prediction-value contract
numerical agreement retroactively repairs v1 provenance
kill_conditions: any input hash or snapshot-path binding mismatch
any accumulator or gate security field indicates outcome or prediction-file access
any summary, ledger, independent gate, or receipt total mismatch
any ledger schema contains a non-structural field
any forbidden file open or credential scan hit
